ebonbane.summary: Sentient Chaotic Evil longsword and Darklord of the Shadowlands: +3 to attack and damage, +3d6 Necrotic against Celestials and Humanoids, and Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects while held. INT 17, WIS 14, CHA 19, hearing and Truesight 120 ft, telepathy with its wielder. Leaving the Shadowlands ends Attunement and sends it home; after 3 days without slaying a Celestial or Humanoid, a DC 17 CHA save at dawn deals 8d8 Force on a success or dominates you on a failure.

harkons-bite.summary: Wolf-tooth necklace: +1 to ability checks and saving throws while worn. Cursed: attuning makes you a Werewolf under the DM's control on full-moon nights, serving Harkon Lukas, and the curse lasts until he dies.
